events.what: World Youth Day Seoul 2027, 3 to 8 August, with the Pope in attendance. Days in the Dioceses run across Korea from 29 July to 2 August. Organisers expect up to a million people at the closing Mass.
events.effect: Major event: peak prices and crowds; accommodation in Seoul will be very tight

sources.title: The WYD Seoul 2027 will take place from 3 to 8 August 2027
sources.authority: Dicastery for Laity, Family and Life (Holy See)
